**Reasoning:**
The Visual Witness Report (confidence 1.00) provides a detailed description of a histological section stained with H&E. The witness identifies a focal, nodular aggregation of cells containing a very large cell with multiple nuclei located around its periphery, which is the characteristic morphology of a Langhans giant cell. This central cell is surrounded by concentric layers of elongated cells (epithelioid cells) and an outer border of small, round cells with dark nuclei (lymphocytes). This specific arrangement is the classic histological presentation of a granuloma, typical of tubercular infections. The visual evidence aligns perfectly with the definition of a classical granuloma with a Langhans giant cell.
